stories.title: Elon Musk's AI company is suing to block a new Minnesota law against certain AI apps
stories.summary: Minnesota has a new law taking effect Saturday to ban AI apps that allow for "nudification." Elon Musk's AI company is suing to block it, saying it violates free speech, noting that it can be used for satire of prominent people.

An infertility doctor secretly fathered dozens of children: how strangers became family. Part 2
stories.summary: Dozens of people who grew up around Philadelphia learned decades later they shared the same biological father, a pioneering infertility doctor. Many bonded, created a family and hold reunions.
